description: Stereo kept by sub-structure extraction and R-group decomposition, read by the C++, Java and Python tests. Atom indices follow the SMILES. In 'expected' an atom that lost a neighbour keeps the hydrogen count it had, as extractSubgraph and extract_subgraph give it; in 'capped' the lost neighbours are replaced by hydrogen, as the Java fragments give it. Both carry the same stereo, and 'stereo' says whether any is kept.
